# Frontier Swarm

> Frontier Swarm is an open-source TypeScript reference implementation for typed, durable multi-agent orchestration on Vercel's eve framework, version 0.81.1.

The reference workflow is Planner → parallel Analyst/Researcher/Builder → parallel Critic/Verifier → Synthesizer. Handoffs use Zod schemas. The project is preview software, has no public benchmark results, and makes no empirical state-of-the-art claim.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Bosheng2020/frontier-swarm/blob/main/README.md): overview, capabilities, installation, limitations, and repository map.
- [简体中文 README](https://github.com/Bosheng2020/frontier-swarm/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese project overview and quick start.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/Bosheng2020/frontier-swarm/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): roles, execution stages, data contracts, and failure semantics.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/Bosheng2020/frontier-swarm/blob/main/docs/faq.md): direct answers to common technical and operational questions.
- [Framework comparison](https://github.com/Bosheng2020/frontier-swarm/blob/main/docs/comparison.md): neutral, official-docs-based capability map for major agent runtimes.

Important: `llms.txt` is a navigation aid based on an informal proposal. It is not an access-control file, benchmark artifact, safety certification, or ranking guarantee.
